posts.author: Hans
posts.content_md:
Yes, they are the same ones matthias. I use the ones listed on page 7 of the second PDF file (the ones with the GU10 fitting because I could not find the ones with the more practical E27 fitting).

I use 3 of them, pointed at the wall of my garage. When I come from full daylight, my eyes take about two minutes to adapt fully to the lighting provided by the amber leds. Slightly faster to the green and red leds (which seem a little more bright to the eye).
